id: title:Gilbert09:add braintrust event and user tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion capability for Braintrust warehouse, including event records, pagination support, and user/project metadata, expanding warehouse ingestion capability.
review.reason: The change adds four new event resource endpoints and metadata for Braintrust warehouse ingestion, including pagination and deduplication support. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in warehouse ingestion, supporting large-scale ingestion without holding all IDs in memory. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in the diff.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit and adoption are not demonstrated; this is a potential benefit, not a realized outcome. No tier assignment is made; only observations are returned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 4 new event resource endpoints to the Braintrust warehouse source, changing metadata and documentation.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds ingestion of event-level records for Braintrust, not just metadata, expanding warehouse warehouse ingestion capability.

observations.behavior: Adds SQLite and fanout-dependent resource support, including a cursor-based paginator and a version filter.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds pagination and deduplication of repeated event IDs within parent records, supporting large-scale ingestion without holding all IDs in memory.

observations.behavior: Replaces monolithic resource construction with a client-config and fanout-dependent resource builder, supporting dependent child resources.
